name: koch-codes
description: Read-only access to Christopher Koch’s public profile: experience, publications, apps and contact details. No authentication, no writes, no personal data beyond what is published on the site.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.title: Get profile
tools.description: Professional profile of Christopher Koch: current role, summary, focus, skills, languages and contact links.

tools.name: list_experience
tools.title: List experience
tools.description: Employment history grouped by organisation, newest first, with role titles, periods and descriptions.

tools.name: list_publications
tools.title: List publications
tools.description: Peer-reviewed and preprint publications on Agentic AI, AI governance and AI-augmented engineering, with arXiv ids and links.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to filter by title or abstract topic.

tools.name: list_apps
tools.title: List apps
tools.description: Published iOS, iPadOS and macOS apps, with App Store links, platform requirements and privacy/support URLs.

tools.name: get_app
tools.title: Get app
tools.description: Details for a single app by slug (for example "freeslots").

tools.name: get_contact
tools.title: Get contact details
tools.description: Email addresses and profile links for contacting Christopher Koch.
